title: Kept ingest worktrees fill the disk. Every clip
notes: that ends rejected or escalated keeps its `brain-ingest-*/<clip_id>`
worktree, which is a full checkout of the instance (2.4 GiB, half `clips/`
and half `brain/`) to keep a 1-3 file draft. The 2026-10-28 daily run
(MacBook, started 06:33) kept 14 of them by 11:27, about 34 GiB, while
free space fell from 58 to 28 GiB; the 11 empty `brain-ingest-*` parents
are clips that published cleanly. Evidence:
`git -C ~/p/wiki worktree list | grep -c brain-ingest` gives 14, every
branch is 0 commits ahead of `origin/main` with 1-3 dirty files. Smallest
next step: keep the draft, not the checkout - save the worktree's diff and
untracked files next to the clip (or in the rejection record) and remove
the worktree, or cut it as a sparse checkout of the pages synthesis
touches; until then, a disk-free guard in `tools/daily/daily.sh` that
result: A refused or escalated clip's synthesis is saved as a commit under refs/ingest-drafts/<clip_id> (branch unmoved, so recovery never publishes it) and its 2.4 GiB checkout is force-removed; the ingest branch stays as the operator marker and the clear command deletes the draft ref too. Any state one commit cannot hold (staged index, ignored files, hidden index entries, gitlinks, unstageable tree) keeps the checkout as before. The 13 kept worktrees of 2026-10-28 were converted: 38 to 71 GiB free.
evidence: clips f6ee82c, fd2fdac, 2aefe5b, 0d1d977 and this commit; pnpm run check 1354 passed; four codex review rounds, each finding fixed; git -C ~/p/wiki for-each-ref refs/ingest-drafts lists 13 with non-empty diffs
